description: This file defines a wizard interface for creating and viewing account move entries in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including form definitions, data processing functions, and wizard states.

classes.name: use_model
classes.description: Wizard interface class for managing account move creation and viewing.

methods.name: _create_entries
methods.description: Creates account move entries and move lines based on selected models.

methods.name: _open_moves
methods.description: Opens a window displaying created account move entries.

methods.name: _check
methods.description: Determines the next state based on the data's model type.
